research_question: How does component evolution with genetic ancestry improve document generation quality in WAFT's two-page generator?
hypothesis: Component evolution with genetic ancestry and trait-based selection will produce higher fitness scores (readability, completeness, constraint satisfaction) compared to non-evolutionary layout algorithms.
objectives: Measure fitness scores of evolved vs. non-evolved component layouts
Track component lineage and identify successful genetic patterns
Analyze user feedback to understand quality improvements
Document evolutionary convergence or divergence patterns
